integrity: Independent published John-contact criteria and the explicitly cited 1982 external Löwner theory are acknowledged; no independent mathematical audit has been performed. A standalone deterministic diagnostic checker accompanies the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only one Euclidean halfspace cut of a ball; dimensions d>=2; nondegenerate -1<t<1; the Gaussian-height limit is pointwise for fixed lambda; no exact finite-dimensional monotonicity of the occupied fraction is claimed; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: A universal regular-simplex John contact frame and Gaussian-window volume law for spherical caps
